## Perplexity (Remote)

Perplexity's hosted MCP server provides web search, source-grounded answers, reasoning, and research through the Perplexity API platform. It offers the same four tools as the official local implementation without a local runtime.

### Setup

Create a Perplexity API account at the [API console](https://console.perplexity.ai), configure API billing or credits, and generate an API key. API usage is billed separately from a Perplexity consumer subscription. Run `thv run perplexity-remote --remote-auth-bearer-token-file <TOKEN_FILE>` to send `Authorization: Bearer <PERPLEXITY_API_KEY>` on requests. The token file contains only the raw API key; if setting the Authorization header directly, include the Bearer prefix in its secret value.

This API-key flow requires no OAuth application, dynamic client registration, browser sign-in, or other custom headers. Calls consume API credits, and research operations can take longer than ordinary searches. See the [official MCP setup guide](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/integrations/mcp-server) for authentication, tools, and client configuration.
